input.explanation: No. The whole fault is in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py: `average_spend_per_item_this_month` divided by the number of this month's purchases without checking for zero. The patch adds that check in the same function, so `render_spend_summary` returns 0 for a shopper with nothing bought this month. `serve_account_page` in src/io_shop/account_page.py then renders that page instead of catching a ZeroDivisionError. Nothing outside this repository needs to change, so monthly-spend-feature can be switched back on once this ships.
